Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They are all over the Continent. Highly mutable.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They are all over the Continent. Highly mutable.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They can float with magic, but they prefer to walk.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They can float with magic, but they prefer to walk.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They are obsessed with mugging travelers, but they don't know how to use what they steal.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They are obsessed with mugging travelers, but they don't know how to use what they steal.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They all have a stick with a skull on it, but no one knows where they get it from.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They all have a stick with a skull on it, but no one knows where they get it from.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is said that it never reveals its face; it is assumed to be some kind of goblin.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is said that it never reveals its face; it is assumed to be some kind of goblin.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They like salt and they never change their pants.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They like salt and they never change their pants.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They grow the mushroom on their back throughout their entire life; if it gets sick they do too.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They grow the mushroom on their back throughout their entire life; if it gets sick they do too.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They tend to go out at night to cause trouble. They have fun playing pranks.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They tend to go out at night to cause trouble. They have fun playing pranks.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They hide in caves hunting by surprising their prey.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They hide in caves hunting by surprising their prey.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They became so obsessed with the sea that they turned blue.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They became so obsessed with the sea that they turned blue.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It has a knife-shaped claw and it is very sharp.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It has a knife-shaped claw and it is very sharp.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They love Zana. They tend to live near trees.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They love Zana. They tend to live near trees.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It covers its eyes so it can look at the sun all day. They say it can see from it's orb.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It covers its eyes so it can look at the sun all day. They say it can see from it's orb.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is permanently lit; it doesn't go out even while sleeping.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is permanently lit; it doesn't go out even while sleeping.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They generate the plants on top of them themselves.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They generate the plants on top of them themselves.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They are so cold that they freeze the moisture in the air which is why they have icicles.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They are so cold that they freeze the moisture in the air which is why they have icicles.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They have so much energy that they cannot sleep.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They have so much energy that they cannot sleep.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Akaw children do not go out at night for fear of encountering them.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Akaw children do not go out at night for fear of encountering them.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It always trembles. It spits hairballs to defend itself.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It always trembles. It spits hairballs to defend itself.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They tend to go in groups. They coordinate to hunt.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They tend to go in groups. They coordinate to hunt.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They are often in a bad mood; they have flashy colors to keep you away.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They are often in a bad mood; they have flashy colors to keep you away.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They live alongside Merkids. They stomp very loudly.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They live alongside Merkids. They stomp very loudly.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They try to hide because they smell bad and people judge them for it.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They try to hide because they smell bad and people judge them for it.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: No one knows where it gets its club to attack.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: No one knows where it gets its club to attack.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is a hatchling that never grows up. Even so it is powerful.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is a hatchling that never grows up. Even so it is powerful.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They live in groups, hidden among the trees.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They live in groups, hidden among the trees.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Secretive creature that appears to protect the forests.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Secretive creature that appears to protect the forests.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They live in a constant frenzy. They can't stay still and hit everything around them.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They live in a constant frenzy. They can't stay still and hit everything around them.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Its favorite pastime is shooting at Razorbeaks to annoy them.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Its favorite pastime is shooting at Razorbeaks to annoy them.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: There is no creature prouder that can live in the snow.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: There is no creature prouder that can live in the snow.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They are enchanted to protect something or someone; they are very good bodyguards.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They are enchanted to protect something or someone; they are very good bodyguards.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It grows moss to hide. The hat is part of its body.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It grows moss to hide. The hat is part of its body.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They enjoy stealing from the powerful; if you are poor they ignore you. They have a strong sense of justice.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They enjoy stealing from the powerful; if you are poor they ignore you. They have a strong sense of justice.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They can't stop generating corrosive acid because they feed on stones. They leave everything a mess.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They can't stop generating corrosive acid because they feed on stones. They leave everything a mess.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They are quite solitary.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They are quite solitary.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It scrapes rust with the spikes in its mouth. It is quite corrosive.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It scrapes rust with the spikes in its mouth. It is quite corrosive.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They settle disputes by showing off their horns thus avoiding hurting each other.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They settle disputes by showing off their horns thus avoiding hurting each other.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They need to be in very hot environments; otherwise they solidify and turn to stone.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They need to be in very hot environments; otherwise they solidify and turn to stone.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Each eye looks in a different direction and has its own will. It decides its actions by majority vote.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Each eye looks in a different direction and has its own will. It decides its actions by majority vote.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It likes humid and toxic areas. It feeds on grime.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It likes humid and toxic areas. It feeds on grime.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: The fur on its neck changes depending on the type of leaves it eats.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: The fur on its neck changes depending on the type of leaves it eats.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They cut through the waves at full speed; it's the only thing that amuses them.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They cut through the waves at full speed; it's the only thing that amuses them.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It lives with a virus that makes it sick, but protects it from worse diseases.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It lives with a virus that makes it sick, but protects it from worse diseases.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They say that if you encounter this creature in the forest it means you are destined for something great.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They say that if you encounter this creature in the forest it means you are destined for something great.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: The eggshell is very hard and it uses it as protection.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: The eggshell is very hard and it uses it as protection.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They feed on fruits and undead.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They feed on fruits and undead.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Their plumage builds up a lot of static. They often accidentally shock each other.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Their plumage builds up a lot of static. They often accidentally shock each other.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They use their helmet to amplify the vibrations produced by their flapping, thus generating electricity.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They use their helmet to amplify the vibrations produced by their flapping, thus generating electricity.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is always in a bad mood because its head is very heavy and it's very hard to move.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is always in a bad mood because its head is very heavy and it's very hard to move.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It hunts at night and sleeps during the day. Sometimes it gets confused, but if it doesn't hunt well during the day it gets frustrated.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It hunts at night and sleeps during the day. Sometimes it gets confused, but if it doesn't hunt well during the day it gets frustrated.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They hide in forests and feed on frightening other creatures.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They hide in forests and feed on frightening other creatures.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They tend to group together to avoid the cold, but with their fur they really don't need to.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They tend to group together to avoid the cold, but with their fur they really don't need to.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It thirsts for revenge, but doesn't even know why.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It thirsts for revenge, but doesn't even know why.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: These creatures had their aim improved after being reanimated.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: These creatures had their aim improved after being reanimated.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: The favorite creature of necromancers obedient yet lethal.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: The favorite creature of necromancers obedient yet lethal.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: He was once a sailor; now he can no longer drown.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: He was once a sailor; now he can no longer drown.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: You can tell if a Banshee is nearby because it gets colder.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: You can tell if a Banshee is nearby because it gets colder.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: The resentment inside turned into heat. Now it is more peaceful.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: The resentment inside turned into heat. Now it is more peaceful.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It tries to bite and bury bones, but its body phases through them since it is a ghost.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It tries to bite and bury bones, but its body phases through them since it is a ghost.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: The central gem controls the rest of the creature. It's not clear why it takes this form.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: The central gem controls the rest of the creature. It's not clear why it takes this form.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It can't stop juggling because the balls burn its hands.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It can't stop juggling because the balls burn its hands.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Every winter solstice it performs a ritual in which it changes its hat.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Every winter solstice it performs a ritual in which it changes its hat.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is said that inside each of their lanterns there is a soul full of rage.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is said that inside each of their lanterns there is a soul full of rage.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Mischievous creature that feeds on the essence of others. It is quite insolent.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Mischievous creature that feeds on the essence of others. It is quite insolent.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They group together to form a smile.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They group together to form a smile.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is said to be a spirit that got trapped inside a tree and ended up becoming corrupted.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is said to be a spirit that got trapped inside a tree and ended up becoming corrupted.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Their bones are said to have a salty taste.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Their bones are said to have a salty taste.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Grimoires that came to life after so much exposure to magic.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Grimoires that came to life after so much exposure to magic.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It still carries out its duty as a protector after years of service.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It still carries out its duty as a protector after years of service.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They concentrate their energy into their halo. They follow orders from higher-ranking androids such as Angels.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They concentrate their energy into their halo. They follow orders from higher-ranking androids such as Angels.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: The angrier it gets the stronger it burns. But it usually forgets why it is angry.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: The angrier it gets the stronger it burns. But it usually forgets why it is angry.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They say it hits tree stumps in mystical rituals.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They say it hits tree stumps in mystical rituals.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They say it helps those who get lost in blizzards.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They say it helps those who get lost in blizzards.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Its mastery of martial arts is such that it doesn't need to use its jaws to fight.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Its mastery of martial arts is such that it doesn't need to use its jaws to fight.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They are capable of traveling over any type of terrain. That's why there are Slimes all over the Continent.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They are capable of traveling over any type of terrain. That's why there are Slimes all over the Continent.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It always has its fuse lit; it can't stop shooting.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It always has its fuse lit; it can't stop shooting.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They camouflage themselves on the water's surface thanks to their scales which reflect sunlight.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They camouflage themselves on the water's surface thanks to their scales which reflect sunlight.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They say it has the soul of a brave warrior. It loves combat, but always with honor.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They say it has the soul of a brave warrior. It loves combat, but always with honor.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Some Merkids learn to use tools a fact that lengthens their limbs.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Some Merkids learn to use tools a fact that lengthens their limbs.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Legend has it that a sailor Akaw cursed it one full moon night.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Legend has it that a sailor Akaw cursed it one full moon night.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: The three heads always argue. The left head is usually right.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: The three heads always argue. The left head is usually right.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: If they lose their doll they go mad.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: If they lose their doll they go mad.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They go from one place to another, wherever the wind takes them. They do not know stress.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They go from one place to another, wherever the wind takes them. They do not know stress.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is surprisingly tough despite being made of sand.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is surprisingly tough despite being made of sand.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They live in a state of sleepwalking. They confuse the real world with their dreams.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They live in a state of sleepwalking. They confuse the real world with their dreams.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They have such good hearing that they can hit their target with their eyes closed.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They have such good hearing that they can hit their target with their eyes closed.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Its body is able to generate clouds through his skin. They are soft to the touch.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Its body is able to generate clouds through his skin. They are soft to the touch.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They build their own blowguns.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They build their own blowguns.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It floats thanks to mystical energy. It is believed to have consciousness.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It floats thanks to mystical energy. It is believed to have consciousness.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They weigh a lot and are quite strong, but they are less violent than they seem.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They weigh a lot and are quite strong, but they are less violent than they seem.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They live in caves and use their hammers to mine and carve out cavities.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They live in caves and use their hammers to mine and carve out cavities.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is said that its mane brings good luck.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is said that its mane brings good luck.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Powerful magical creature that controls water in its gaseous state.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Powerful magical creature that controls water in its gaseous state.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Its weapon is like a part of his body.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Its weapon is like a part of his body.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It reacts violently to unexpected encounters, but it's out of embarrassment.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It reacts violently to unexpected encounters, but it's out of embarrassment.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: He uses a special feather as a sword.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: He uses a special feather as a sword.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is made up of rocks that got tired of being destroyed to obtain Oranite.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is made up of rocks that got tired of being destroyed to obtain Oranite.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Its surprisingly hard jaw is made of solidified lava.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Its surprisingly hard jaw is made of solidified lava.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: This creature controls better its tail rather than its hands.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: This creature controls better its tail rather than its hands.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It has no claws, so it learned martial arts to defend itself.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It has no claws, so it learned martial arts to defend itself.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It controls the flow of air inside it at will, which is why it is able to float.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It controls the flow of air inside it at will, which is why it is able to float.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They originated in the underworld and reached the surface due to tectonic movements.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They originated in the underworld and reached the surface due to tectonic movements.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They are used to hunting in freezing conditions.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They are used to hunting in freezing conditions.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: When the stones on its body rub together it creates sparks with which it lights sticks on fire.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: When the stones on its body rub together it creates sparks with which it lights sticks on fire.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It lives in a constant state of panic because it is burning. But its fur resists fire so it is not really in danger.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It lives in a constant state of panic because it is burning. But its fur resists fire so it is not really in danger.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They can remain buried under the sand for over a week.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They can remain buried under the sand for over a week.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Its breath can reach -100°C.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Its breath can reach -100°C.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It raids caravans, taking advantage of the unbearable heat of the desert.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It raids caravans, taking advantage of the unbearable heat of the desert.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Its head is very shiny; it's proud of it.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Its head is very shiny; it's proud of it.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Their internal organs are capable of generating electricity.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Their internal organs are capable of generating electricity.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is believed that its orb can communicate with the moons.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is believed that its orb can communicate with the moons.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: If a Slime spends too long in corrupt environments it ends up becoming corrupted and transforming into this creature.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: If a Slime spends too long in corrupt environments it ends up becoming corrupted and transforming into this creature.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Life after death didn't suppress its need to ambush adventurers.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Life after death didn't suppress its need to ambush adventurers.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Other undead fear this creature for being unpredictable and violent.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Other undead fear this creature for being unpredictable and violent.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Doll containing a tormented soul. Now it seeks the one responsible.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Doll containing a tormented soul. Now it seeks the one responsible.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Once a year they gather to celebrate their birthday. They are usually solitary.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Once a year they gather to celebrate their birthday. They are usually solitary.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is a difficult creature to control as it attacks any entity that approaches it.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is a difficult creature to control as it attacks any entity that approaches it.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Their balls smell quite bad.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Their balls smell quite bad.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It perceives its surroundings through changes in air pressure. It can detect a breath from over 100 meters away.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It perceives its surroundings through changes in air pressure. It can detect a breath from over 100 meters away.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They never tire of scaring farmers. But they also scare other creatures so it's worth it for the farmers for the sake of their crops.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They never tire of scaring farmers. But they also scare other creatures so it's worth it for the farmers for the sake of their crops.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They have great magical powers, but they are more interested in having fun than in fighting.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They have great magical powers, but they are more interested in having fun than in fighting.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is the offspring of a disturbing and powerful entity. It can only grow by feeding on the innocence of its victims.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is the offspring of a disturbing and powerful entity. It can only grow by feeding on the innocence of its victims.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They have great skill with the sword for being undead.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They have great skill with the sword for being undead.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It still searches for its crew even after death.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It still searches for its crew even after death.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Its horn is even harder than the rest of its body.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Its horn is even harder than the rest of its body.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They love the cold so much that they turned into ice.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They love the cold so much that they turned into ice.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Creature that carries an ancestral curse.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Creature that carries an ancestral curse.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Its gaze is always vacant yet it is aware of everything happening around it.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Its gaze is always vacant yet it is aware of everything happening around it.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They love music so much that they generate energy by playing.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They love music so much that they generate energy by playing.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is said to come from nightmares while sleeping in the forest at night.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is said to come from nightmares while sleeping in the forest at night.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: The mechanisms inside it allow it to move freely almost like a living being.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: The mechanisms inside it allow it to move freely almost like a living being.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: The fuel they use is divine faith. Their existence is proof that their god exists and that is enough for them to function.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: The fuel they use is divine faith. Their existence is proof that their god exists and that is enough for them to function.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Their hands can melt metals. They can't turn them off, so they spend the day causing chaos.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Their hands can melt metals. They can't turn them off, so they spend the day causing chaos.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Magical creature of the forests. It is said that their true soul resides in their hammer.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Magical creature of the forests. It is said that their true soul resides in their hammer.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Snow creature. With a single clap, they can trigger an avalanche.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Snow creature. With a single clap, they can trigger an avalanche.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Elite warrior. They can defeat entire battalions alone.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Elite warrior. They can defeat entire battalions alone.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is believed that they carry the souls of an entire crew. Their greed knows no bounds.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is believed that they carry the souls of an entire crew. Their greed knows no bounds.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It forms from the anchors of shipwrecks after years under the sea. It is said to hold the soul of the ship.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It forms from the anchors of shipwrecks after years under the sea. It is said to hold the soul of the ship.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It eats impressively every three months. Then it sleeps until the next time.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It eats impressively every three months. Then it sleeps until the next time.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They have been inhabiting the continent for hundreds of years; in times past they were a guardian.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They have been inhabiting the continent for hundreds of years; in times past they were a guardian.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They are quite irritable, but they try to control themselves because when they get angry, a storm is generated.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They are quite irritable, but they try to control themselves because when they get angry, a storm is generated.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They seem to have a connection with alchemical runes. They are very ancient.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They seem to have a connection with alchemical runes. They are very ancient.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is said that with their hand they are able to travel to another dimension.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is said that with their hand they are able to travel to another dimension.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They wagged their tail so much that it caught fire.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They wagged their tail so much that it caught fire.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They have no friends because they can't suppress the urge to hit them with a club.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They have no friends because they can't suppress the urge to hit them with a club.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: They absorb the souls of buried corpses to feed themselves.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: They absorb the souls of buried corpses to feed themselves.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: The ancient inhabitants of the Continent associated this creature with the sun.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: The ancient inhabitants of the Continent associated this creature with the sun.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Its wings are made of electricity; the more charge it builds the larger they grow.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Its wings are made of electricity; the more charge it builds the larger they grow.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Curious creature with great potential.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Curious creature with great potential.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Legendary weapon, forged with the eye of an acnestral demon. It has a life of its own.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Legendary weapon, forged with the eye of an acnestral demon. It has a life of its own.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: It is said that the reflection of moonlight on this creature changes according to the lunar phase.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: It is said that the reflection of moonlight on this creature changes according to the lunar phase.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Ancestral demon that survived the great war.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Ancestral demon that survived the great war.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: Dragonid that has renounced honor and has taken the path of forbidden arts.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: Dragonid that has renounced honor and has taken the path of forbidden arts.

Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.SourceString: A military robot from a forgotten civilization. It is believed capable of defending entire cities.
Description_62_B028C92748664F2DA09DBA83A.LocalizedString: A military robot from a forgotten civilization. It is believed capable of defending entire cities.
